title: Quantitative uniqueness for parabolic equations with Hölder potentials
summary: In this note we derive a space-like quantitative uniqueness result for parabolic operators with Hölder zero-order term that interpolates between the Donnelly-Fefferman and the Bourgain-Kenig estimate. This generalizes a recent result of Teng, Wang and Zhu for the time-independent Schrödinger operator with a Hölder potential.
